name: Fuyuhito
source: Fifth Sword and older brother of Haru[spoiler] and Natsu[/spoiler]. Despite running the same blood with Kotodama user sisters, he doesn't have the godly ability so he had no choice but to rely on his own power to join the Eight Swords. His powers are Ice control and pure swordsmanship.
translation: Fifth Sword and older brother of Haru[spoiler] and Natsu[/spoiler]. Despite running the same blood with Kotodama user sisters, he doesn't have the godly ability so he had no choice but to rely on his own power to join the Eight Swords. His powers are Ice control and pure swordsmanship.
